purpose: Separate different kinds of authority that often get confused in the dying room.

authority_types.example: the person who knows what the dying person would want

authority_types.risk: varies by law and cannot be inferred by the cube

authority_types.example: the person who has done months of daily care
authority_types.risk: labor may be ignored or over-extracted

authority_types.example: hospital, hospice, care home, morgue, funeral home, court, state
authority_types.risk: may erase family/chosen-family knowledge or launder opaque systems

authority_types.example: tradition holder, elder, clergy, community practice
who gets to tell the story after death
authority_types.risk: may harm living people or hide others

hard_rule: The cube may describe that authority is contested. It may not decide who has authority in any real case.
